npcs.chat_cooldown: ⏳ {name} has nothing more to say for now. Come back in {minutes} minutes.

elara.advice: Match your crops to your lands! Greenhouses are perfect for tropical seeds like cocoa and coffee.
elara.bio: I am Elara, guardian of the village gardens and pet stables. I believe in harmony between technology and nature.
elara.chat: The sprouts are looking so green today. Make sure to feed your pets so they don't go hungry!
elara.greeting_high: Hello dear! Nature itself sings in your presence.
elara.greeting_low: Hello. Please take care of the earth and the pets.
elara.greeting_med: Lovely to see you. My plants are growing wonderfully today.
elara.hint: (Likes mystery eggs, star fruits, golden apples, seeds, and berries)
elara.role: I help with farming and pets. High affinity with me will reduce your crops' grow time by up to 20%.

gamblebot.advice: Always double down on a 11 in Blackjack, but never bet money you cannot afford to lose!
gamblebot.bio: I am GambleBot, a state-of-the-art croupier robot designed to run the local Casino and maximize entertainment (and risk!).
gamblebot.chat: Beep boop! Calculating winning probability... 99% chance that you should play slots right now.
gamblebot.greeting_high: Hey partner! Who are we squeezing today?
gamblebot.greeting_low: Hello human. Have you tried your luck today?
gamblebot.greeting_med: Glad to see you. Looks like you bet wisely.
gamblebot.hint: (Likes shiny gold things, cheat coins, and VIP tickets)
gamblebot.role: I manage the village Casino. Boosting your reputation with me will unlock a shop discount (up to 20%).

npcs.gift_prompt: What would you like to offer? {hint}

irian.advice: Be fast! Ocean fishing has a very narrow bite window, but it's where the most legendary beasts dwell.
irian.bio: I am Irian, ranger of the wilds and keeper of the docks. I track creatures through the forests and the deep ocean alike.
irian.chat: Just looking at the horizon... They say a giant Kraken roams the deep waters when the sky turns dark.
irian.greeting_high: Ah, my captain! The tides are favorable today.
irian.greeting_med: Hey sailor. Smelt the sea breeze lately?
irian.hint: (Likes kraken tentacles, whales, sharks, and fish)
irian.role: I help hunters and fishers alike. High affinity with me will extend your fishing bite window and improve your hunting instincts.

thorek.advice: Mining is about managing risk. Don't dig too deep if your bag is full, or the mine will collapse on your loot!
thorek.bio: I am Thorek, the village blacksmith and miner. I spent years in the deep mountain strata of Hoak Haven.
thorek.chat: Clang! Clang! Just working on a new pickaxe prototype. Hard work builds character, lad.
thorek.greeting_high: Hello my friend! My forge is always open for a hard worker like you.
thorek.greeting_low: What do you want? If you don't have a pickaxe, you're wasting my time.
thorek.greeting_med: Ah, there you are! Found any good ore lately?
thorek.hint: (Likes gold nuggets, diamonds, platinum, and ores)
thorek.role: I refine metals and help miners. High affinity with me will grant a passive reduction to your mining risk (up to -20 risk).
